bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; LOG=/tmp/gace-posting-baseline-build.log; test -f "$LOG" || exit 31; LINES=$(grep -Ei 'ERROR|failed|denied|No space|network|resolve|unavailable|not found|cannot|permission|certificate|timeout' "$LOG" | tail -n 12 | cut -c1-220 || true); test -n "$LINES" || LINES=$(tail -n 8 "$LOG" | cut -c1-180); gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "$(printf 'GAYBBS_BASELINE_BUILD_DIAGNOSTIC_20261113\n%s' "$LINES")" >/dev/null; echo BASELINE_BUILD_ERROR_RECORDED
